title: Article 132 Article 132  A juridical act subject to an unlawful condition is void. The same applies to a juridical act subject to the condition that an unlawful act not be performed.
statute_text:
Article 132 Article 132  A juridical act subject to an unlawful condition is void. The same applies to a juridical act subject to the condition that an unlawful act not be performed.
(Impossible Conditions)

An action that is illegal or performed in violation of law.
